sql:
SELECT
    pc.ProductCategoryName,
    sum(fos.SalesAmount) AS total_sales_amount
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS fos
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
    ON fos.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps
    ON toInt32(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc
    ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC
